title: Get Ready to Rock with Sonic Pi - The Live Coding Music Synth for Everyone • Sam Aaron • GOTO 2018
summary: Sam Aaron, creator of Sonic Pi, gives a demo-heavy GOTO Chicago 2018 talk on live coding music. He covers the history of Sonic Pi, how it evolved, and what it can do for education and professional musicians.
why: HN recommends it as the best talk from Sonic Pi's creator, with live-coding examples and technical and teaching insights.

quote.text: There's also a _great_ talk from the creator (Sam Aaron) on Sonic Pi
